_Posted by Kunal's robot (Claude Opus 5.5) ↓_
>
> ## Motivation
>
> `determine_tensor_transport_mode()` falls back to inline (pickled) feature transport whenever `nnodes > 1`. With pipeline parallelism, only the first stage's TP group reads tokenizer output, so shared memory still works when that group sits on node 0 with the tokenizer:
>
> ```
> node 0                            node 1..n
> tokenizer --shm--> PP0 TP group   PP1..PPn (requests relayed by PP0)
> ```
>
> Launchers that start one process group per GPU report even a single-host PP engine as `nnodes == pp_size`. In that setup the tokenizer manager pickles every request's decoded pixel tensors (hundreds of MB for several large images) on its event loop, which stalls all other requests and `/health`.
>
> ## Modifications
>
> - Keep shared-memory transport when `nnodes > 1` if each TP group fits on one node (`nnodes <= pp_size`), there are no data-parallel replicas (`dp_size == 1`), and the launch does not use Ray, whose placement groups can put any rank on any node.
> - Extend `test_tensor_transport_mode.py` with the PP, DP and Ray cases.
>
> The first stage still pickles materialized features when it relays requests to the next stage. That is unchanged by this PR and could be a follow-up.
>
> This PR is independent of #44575 and #44576, which address the same workload.
>
> ## Accuracy Tests
>
> Not applicable: the change only picks the transport for feature tensors.
>
> ## Speed Tests and Profiling
>
> A PP8 prefill server under image traffic for 30 minutes: 0.2 requests per second, 4 images per request, 59k to 74k prompt tokens. Base is `main`; fixed has this PR and #44575 and #44576.
>
> | Metric | Base | Fixed |
> |---|---|---|
> | `/v1/models` p90 | 70 ms | under 5 ms |
> | `/v1/models` p99 | 550 ms | under 5 ms |
> | `/v1/models` max | 1.08 s | 10 ms |
> | `/health` probes over 5 s | 143 | 14 |
> | Request p50 | 15.3 s | 13.1 s |
>
> ## Checklist
>
> - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
> - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
> - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
> - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
> - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 
 from typing import Literal
 
-from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_device, get_parallel
 
 TensorTransportMode = Literal["cuda_ipc", "auto", "default"]
 
@@ -14,7 +14,26 @@ def determine_tensor_transport_mode() -> TensorTransportMode:
     inject the address only into scheduler actors for a multi-node deployment,
     and external launchers may use an environment-based rendezvous instead.
     """
-    if get_parallel().nnodes > 1:
+    if not _tokenizer_consumers_on_first_node():
         # CUDA IPC and POSIX shared memory are local to one node.
         return "default"
     return "cuda_ipc"
+
+
+def _tokenizer_consumers_on_first_node() -> bool:
+    """Whether every scheduler that reads tokenizer output shares node 0 with it.
+
+    Only the first pipeline stage's TP group reads tokenizer output, and it
+    stays on node 0 unless a TP group spans nodes; later stages receive
+    requests from that group, never from the tokenizer.
+    """
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    if parallel.nnodes == 1:
+        return True
+    # Ray placement groups can put any rank on any node, and data-parallel
+    # replicas spread across nodes.
+    return (
+        not get_device().use_ray
+        and parallel.dp_size == 1
+        and parallel.nnodes <= parallel.pp_size
+    )

@@ -27,6 +27,22 @@ def test_transport_mode_uses_published_node_topology(self):
                 ):
                     self.assertEqual(determine_tensor_transport_mode(), expected)
 
+    def test_multi_node_pipeline_keeps_first_stage_local(self):
+        # Only the first pipeline stage reads tokenizer output; it stays on
+        # node 0 as long as each TP group fits on one node.
+        cases = (
+            (dict(nnodes=8, pp_size=8), "cuda_ipc"),
+            (dict(nnodes=2, pp_size=8), "cuda_ipc"),
+            (dict(nnodes=4, pp_size=2), "default"),
+            (dict(nnodes=2, pp_size=2, dp_size=2), "default"),
+            (dict(nnodes=8, pp_size=8, use_ray=True), "default"),
+        )
+
+        for overrides, expected in cases:
+            with self.subTest(**overrides):
+                with get_context().override_server_args(**overrides):
+                    self.assertEqual(determine_tensor_transport_mode(), expected)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
